label: playable
description: First-pass pull list: self-contained and readable in one sentence. EDHREC rank ≤ 15000, plus simple creature bodies added back by rule. A starting point to correct, not a verdict.

label: activated ability
description: Cards with activated abilities.

label: single target instant/sorcery
description: Instant/sorcery spells that may target only one target. This is materially important for some effects that care about single targets. Not mutually exclusive with [multiple targets](/tags/card/multiple-targets).

label: spot removal
description: Removal for one target specifically.  See also [sweeper](sweeper) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

label: alliteration
description: Cards that alliterate, either properly or per Treacherous Trapezist.

label: evasion
description: Creatures that are harder to block through keywords (flying, menace) or other means.

label: virtual vanilla
description: These creatures are effectively just vanilla after entering the battlefield. They may have an enters-the-battlefield or on-cast trigger.

label: repeatable crime
description: Repeatable ways to commit crimes by targeting an opponent or something they control.

label: unique type line
description: No other card has this same type line. Acorn, playtest, and rebalanced cards may count as unique, but they don't make non-acorn, non-playtest, non-rebalanced cards stop counting as unique.

label: french vanilla
description: These creatures, vehicles and spacecraft have only keyword abilities.

label: playable-substrate
description: On the pull list by the add-back rule rather than by EDHREC: a creature with evergreen keywords only and ≤ 55 characters of rules text. Commander under-plays these; a kids’ deck runs on them.

label: virtual french vanilla
description: Creatures and vehicles that are french vanilla (having only keyword abilities) after entering the battlefield. They may have "enters the battlefield" or "on cast" trigger.

label: intervening if clause
description: At/When/Whenever [event], if [clause], [effect].

label: cheaper than mv
description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be lower than the card's mana value.

label: combat trick
description: Effects that can be used during combat to help a creature survive, destroy opposing creatures, or deal additional combat damage.

label: pure draw
description: Spells and abilities that let you draw (a) card(s) without discarding other cards or sacrificing other permanents.

label: gives pp counters
description: Cards that give +1/+1 counters. For permanents that only give +1/+1 counters to themselves, see [gains pp counters](gains-pp-counters).

label: multiple targets
description: These cards can target more than one object or player. Not mutually exclusive with [single target instant/sorcery](/tags/card/single-target-instant-sorcery).

label: namesake spell
description: Spells (or, mostly spells) with names that identify them with a specific named character.

label: attacking matters-self
description: Cards that care about themselves attacking. See also [attacking matters](attacking-matters) for cards that care about attacking in general.

label: repeatable pp counters
description: Repeatable ways of putting +1/+1 counters on creatures.

label: alternative cost
description: Spells with alternative casting costs, which may be cheaper or more expensive than their mana costs. See CR 118.9.

label: lifegain
description: Cards that cause you to gain life.

label: cantrip
description: Cards that let you draw a card as they resolve or enter the battlefield.

label: cast trigger-you
description: Whenever you cast X, do something.

label: more expensive than mv
description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be higher than the card's mana value. See also [cards with X in their mana cost](https://scryfall.com/search?q=m%3Ax).

label: single english word name
description: Cards named with a single word in English. This may be a compound word.

label: noncreature typal
description: Cards that care about creature types, but not necessarily on a creature card—so they're compatible with the Kindred cards from Lorwyn, for example.

label: additional cost
description: Spells with additional costs. See CR 118.8.

label: exile-self
description: Cards which exile themselves (from the battlefield, from the graveyard, from your hand, etc.)

label: drawback
description: Cards that have some kind of disadvantage.

label: attacking matters
description: Cards that care about attacking. See also [attacking matters-self](attacking-matters-self) for cards that care about themselves attacking.

label: activate from hand
description: Activated abilities that can be activated from your hand.

label: bottomless mana sink
description: Repeatable effects that, if an arbitrary amount of mana is dumped into them, will probably win you the game—for example, by drawing your whole deck, creating an arbitrarily large attacker, making an endless army of tokens, gaining infinite life, etc.

label: mana sink
description: Cards with repeatable effects that you can dump a bunch of mana (at least 3) into each turn.

label: death trigger-self
description: Permanents with abilities that trigger when they die.

label: burn any
description: Cards that burn any target: players, creatures, battles, or planeswalkers.

label: draw engine
description: Card draw effects that can net you additional cards repeatedly over time. Contrast [Burst Draw](burst-draw), which nets you multiple cards right away.

label: out of color token
description: Cards which create tokens which are one or more colours the original card isn't.

label: modal
description: Spells which give you your choice from two or more distinct functions.

label: repeatable creature tokens
description: Repeatable ways to create creature tokens

label: group slug
description: Cards that are able to deal damage or otherwise target multiple players at once.

label: removal-toughness
description: Removal that can kill creatures by reducing their toughness to 0 or less.

label: protects-creature
description: Effects that can protect a creature, e.g. with protection,  hexproof, indestructible, etc.

label: delayed trigger
description: Create a triggered ability that may trigger later. Similar to a [reflexive trigger](reflexive-trigger).

label: playable-friction
description: On the pull list but carries a mechanic that costs an explanation or a deck built around it (storm, cascade, evoke…). Check these by eye — most are build-arounds.

label: enters in company
description: Creatures that come with more creatures attached on ETB without reanimating them.

label: power boost to all
description: Cards that provide power to all creatures you control. May be limited to certain types or colors.

label: repeatable pure draw
description: Repeatable ways to draw a card with no additional cost or sacrifice, such as discarding a card

label: tutor-to-hand
description: Cards that tutor cards to the player's hand.

label: tutor-land-basic
description: Cards that tutor basic land cards.

label: scry
description: See also [scry-like](scry-like) for effects that are like scry, but don't use the keyword.

label: castable from exile
description: Cards you can cast or access from exile.

label: martyr
description: Creatures that sacrifice themselves for benefit.

label: pinger
description: Effects that deal just 1-2 damage repeatedly.

label: discard
description: Gets cards out of your opponent's hand and into their graveyard.

label: mana dork
description: Creatures which can repeatedly generate mana

label: self-replacement effect
description: A resolving spell or ability partially or completely replacing one of its own effects.

label: bear with set's mechanic
description: A 2/2 for 2 with one of the set's iconic mechanics

label: castable from graveyard
description: Cards you can cast or access from the graveyard.

label: death trigger
description: Abilities that trigger from permanents being sent to a graveyard. See also [leaves trigger](leaves-battlefield-trigger).

label: drain life
description: Hurt your opponent and gain life to match.

label: land ramp
description: Ramp spells that net you more lands on your side of the battlefield.

label: multi removal
description: Removal for more than one, but less than all.  See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [sweeper](sweeper).

label: surveil
description: Cards that let you look at the top # cards of your library and put some into the graveyard.

label: egg
description: Artifacts that have to be sacrificed to do something.

label: mini refund
description: Immediately gives you a small amount of mana or untapped lands back (typically no more than about one-third of the mana cost you paid)

label: regrowth-creature
description: Return a creature from the graveyard to the hand

label: repeatable sacrifice outlet
description: Repeatedly sacrifice stuff.

label: ramp
description: Effects that increase available mana for current or later turns.

label: mill-self
description: Cards that put cards from top of your own library to the graveyard. Check the tag "mill" for more.

label: burn with set's mechanic
description: Burn spells that have the mechanic of the set they debuted in.

label: enlarge
description: Effects that give a creature +N/+M. These values should be significant—usually at least +3/+3 or better, roundabouts.

label: sacrifice self
description: Permanents that have abilities that make them sacrifice themselves.

label: discount-self
description: Cards that have a way to reduce their own cost

label: shade pump
description: Effects that give an arbitrary amount of +1/+1 until end of turn. See also [firebreathing](firebeathing) in red and [armoring](armoring) in white.

label: firebreathing
description: Give a creature +X/+0 until end of turn via an activated ability.

label: multiple bodies
description: One-shot effects that put two or more creatures onto the battlefield on resolution.

label: creaturefall
description: Cards that care about a creature entering the battlefield. Also known as Alliance in New Capenna.

label: punny name
description: Names that are puns or otherwise a play on words

label: burst draw
description: Card draw effects that can net you a bunch of cards at once. As a rule of thumb, to qualify for this tag, the card should let you draw at least three cards at a time and come out ahead by at least +1.

label: giant growth
description: Combat tricks that give a creature +N/+N. See also [Enlarge](enlarge).

label: life for cards
description: Get cards in exchange for your life (damage causes loss of life).

label: offcolor ability
description: Abilities with a mana cost outside the card's colors.

label: crew
description: Compilation tag for the Crew keyword. Should be 1:1 with [kw:crew](https://scryfall.com/search?q=kw%3Acrew).

label: hate-set-mechanic
description: Cards that "hate" on one or more mechanics in the set they were printed in.

label: keyword anthem
description: Give your entire team a keyword.

label: sweeper
description: _o\ Destroy all the things! See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

label: jump
description: A creature gains flying until end of turn.

label: landfall
description: Cards which reward you for playing lands.

label: utility mana rock
description: Mana rocks that do extra things.

label: adds multiple mana
description: Cards that net you more than one mana at a time.

label: reflexive trigger
description: An ability that triggers based on actions taken earlier during a spell or ability's resolution.

label: block trigger
description: Effects that trigger on a creature blocking or becoming blocked.

label: gives vigilance
description: See also [untapper-creature](untapper-creature).

label: reanimate-creature
description: Return creature cards currently in the graveyard to the battlefield. Not to be confused with [cheat death](/tags/card/cheat-death), which interacts right as the creature dies.

label: gives castable from exile
description: Cards that let you cast things from exile.

label: refund
description: Immediately get mana or untapped lands back.

label: tap fuel-creature
description: Tap a creature to pay for/activate an effect

label: freeze-creature
description: Prevent a creature from untapping for its next N untaps. For effects that prevent untapping indefinitely, see [lockdown](lockdown-creature).

label: anthem
description: Your entire team gets +N/+N. Possibly limited to creature types or colors.

label: saboteur
description: Effects that trigger when you deal damage to an opponent.

label: scales with power
description: Effects which scale with the power of one or more creatures.

label: disenchant/naturalize
description: Cards that remove artifacts and/or enchantments.

label: one-sided fight
description: A creature deals damage equal to its power to another. Like Fight, but without the chance to fight back. See also [fling](/tags/card/fling) which involves sacrificing the creature.

label: renew
description: Exile this card from your graveyard: Do a thing. Doesn't need to be the specific Renew keyword, just cards that have an ability to exile themselves in the graveyard.

label: cards in graveyard matter
description: Mechanics that care about the cards in one or more graveyards.

label: mulch
description: An effect that filters cards at the top of the library, putting remainders into the graveyard.

label: reanimate-self
description: These cards can return themselves to the battlefield if they're sitting in the graveyard. Not to be confused with [cheat death-self](cheat-death-self), where the card returns immediately after dying.

label: repeatable surveil
description: See also: [repeatable scry](repeatable-scry).

label: counterspell-soft
description: A "soft counterspell" gives the other player a chance to buy off the counter, such as with a mana payment.

label: leaves body behind
description: Creatures that create one or more creature bodies when they die.

label: low mana value matters
description: Effects that care about your things with mana value below some boundary value, usually 2 to 4.

label: portmanteau
description: Cards named with a portmanteau—a word that's a combination of two words.

label: rhystic
description: Effects that opponents can buy off if they pay mana.

label: creates bigger body
description: Creature cards that generate additional creatures beefier than themselves. (Typically this means having a higher total power and toughness than the original creature.)
aliases: say hello to my little friend

label: shrink
description: Nerf a creature's power, temporarily or otherwise. Not to be confused with [humble](humble).

label: type addition human
description:
Creatures that weren't previously a human and just identified by their job, despite being a human, and then gained that type.

Creatures that had a strange type line from before standardisation, then jumped straight to being human aren't counted in this

label: cast trigger-self
description: Cards that have a trigger when they are cast

label: discard outlet
description: Ways to discard your own cards.

label: mill-any
description: Cards that let you choose a library to mill. Could be yours, could be theirs. It could also be an indirect choice, e.g. milling the controller of a targeted permanent.

label: repeatable scry
description: See also: [repeatable surveil](repeatable-surveil).

label: symmetrical
description: Cards that affect the whole battlefield/all players in symmetrical, equal manner.

label: activate from graveyard
description: Abilities that can be activated from inside a graveyard.

label: ferocious
description: Cards that care about you controlling creatures with power 4 or greater.

label: force draw
description: Force an opponent to draw cards, whether they like it or not. The lesser used mode on Ancestral Recall.

label: loot
description: Draw a card, then discard a card. Mainly blue. See also [rummage](/tags/card/rummage), the red version, which discards then draws.

label: energy generator
description: Cards that in some way give you energy counters.

label: morbid
description: Effects that care about at least one creature dying this turn.

label: uninspired
description: Effects that trigger when something becomes tapped. For cards that care about tapped permanents, see [synergy-tapped](synergy-tapped) and [tapped matters-self](tapped-matters-self).

label: rummage
description: Discard a card, then draw a card. Mainly red. See also [loot](/tags/card/loot), the blue version, which draws then discards.

label: ward
description: Collection tag for the Ward keyword. Should be 1:1 with kw:ward.

label: copy-self
description: Cards that make a copy of themselves

label: bombard-self
description: Sacrifice this permanent to deal N damage. See also [fling-self](/tags/card/fling-self), [bombard](bombard).

label: mix-and-match
description: Two or more non-evergreen mechanics blended together on the same card.

label: pacifism
description: A form of removal that prevents a creature from attacking, and usually also from blocking and/or activating its abilities.

label: aesthetic counter
description: Counters that have no rules meaning, just aesthetic.

label: hate-high-pt
description: Cards that specifically hate on cards with high power or toughness, typically at least 3-4.

label: mana filter
description: Convert mana to other colors.

label: fun ruling
description: Cards with rulings where the rules manager is having fun with us. Not necessarily laugh-out-loud funny.

label: humble
description: Nerf a creature's stats and/or abilities as a form of removal. See also [shapechange](/tags/card/shapechange), [swap removal](swap-removal) and [deanimate](deanimate).

label: restricted mana
description: Mana that has restrictions on what you can or cannot use it on.

label: thoughtseize
description: Opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card for them to discard.

label: convoke
description: Cards that let you tap creatures to pay less or no mana for them.

label: doom blade
description: 2 MV "Destroy target creature, unless it's X"

label: heroic
description: Whenever you cast a spell targeting your permanent, something good happens.

label: per-player
description: Effects that scale positively with the number of players; i. e., "for each player", "for each opponent", etc.

label: repeatable card advantage
description: Things that give you access to more cards, repeatably.

label: offcolor additional cost
description: Cards with an additional cost of mana beyond the card's own colors.

label: curiosity
description: Draw cards when dealing damage to an opponent

label: cast on resolution
description: Spells and abilities that let you cast spells as part of their resolution.

label: life payment
description: Cards that cost life to use; not necessarily with the "pay" keyword.

label: poisonous
description: Makes, or is, a creature that poisons a player when it hits them.

label: type errata
description: Cards that were printed with a type-line that has since been updated. For cards whose token generation has changed, see [Token Errata](token-errata).

label: free sacrifice outlet
description: Ways to sacrifice a permanent repeatedly that require no additional cost.

label: gives mm counters
description: Cards that give -1/-1 counters.

label: graveyard fuel-creature
description: Exiles creatures from the graveyard for value

label: sweeper-one-sided
description: Sweepers that are, or have high potential to be, one-sided.

label: type addition phyrexian
description: Gained the Phyrexian type, either after it was introduced with the big sweep at Modern Horizons 2 launch, or at a later date.

label: cda-power
description: Creatures that have their power determined by a characteristic-defining ability.

label: land count matters
description: Specifically your land count, not [your opponent's](opponent-land-count-matters).

label: regrowth-self
description: Cards that can return themselves from the graveyard to the hand.

label: french vanilla aura
description: Auras that give stat changes and/or keywords with no other effects.

label: shapechange
description: Set creatures' power/toughness, not necessarily a nerf. See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).

label: bombard
description: Sacrifice something else to deal N damage. See also [fling](/tags/card/fling), [bombard-self](bombard-self).

label: counterspell
description: Spells that counter stuff. See child tags for variants on the behaviour; notably [counterspell-soft](/tags/card/counterspell-soft) which gives the opponent a buyout cost.

label: exile-self-dfc-transform
description: DFCs that exile themselves as part of their transformation.

label: graveyard fuel
description: Cards that require exiling other cards in graveyard as a cost for abilities and effects.

label: man-o'-war
description: Creatures that can bounce your opponent's stuff when they enter the battlefield.

label: non mana ability mana
description: Abilities that produce mana, but aren't mana abilities (as defined by CR 605.1)

label: staple with set's mechanic
description: A common card design that is related to one or more of the main mechanics in a set

label: animate self
description: Noncreatures that can become creatures. For creatures that can stop being creatures, see [deanimate self](deanimate-self).

label: artifactfall
description: Cards that care about an artifact entering the battlefield.

label: drain creature
description: Hurt a creature and gain life to match.

label: unique mana cost
description: This card's mana cost isn't found on any other card.

label: disintegrate
description: Damaged creatures are exiled instead of dying.

label: exhaust
description: Abilities that you can only activate once.

label: multi land ramp
description: Land ramp that (potentially) nets two or more lands on your side of the battlefield

label: card types in graveyard matter
description: Cards that care about the card types of cards in a graveyard.

label: discarded type matters
description: The type of card you discard matters for some effect.

label: enchantmentfall
description: Cards that care about enchantments entering the batllefield.

label: hate-discard
description: Your opponent had better think twice before targeting you with that [Mind Rot](https://tagger.scryfall.com/card/ori/281)!

label: living weapon
description: Equipments that attach themselves to a creature they create on ETB.

label: plunder
description: Sacrifice something else to draw cards.

label: second spell matters
description: Cards that care when the player casting or controlling them casts their second spell for the turn.

label: banish
description: Exile things as long as this permanent remains.

label: free-cast-another
description: Cast other things without paying their mana cost.

label: rhyming name
description: Cards whose names contain a rhyme, or come very close to it.

label: second draw matters
description: Cards that care when the player casting or controlling them draws their second card for the turn.

label: cheat death
description: Return a creature or permanent to the battlefield or to your hand at the moment it dies.

label: regrowth-instant
description: Effects that put an instant back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: threshold
description: Cards that care about you having seven or more cards in your graveyard.

label: amount spent matters
description: The amount of mana you spent to do the thing matters.

label: long term impulsive draw
description: Impulsive draw effects that let you play the exiled cards beyond this turn, letting you untap and have access to your full resources.

label: pair-commander
description: These cards can be one half of a two-card pair of commanders

label: regrowth-sorcery
description: Effects that put a sorcery back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: combat ramp
description: Generate mana/more lands by attacking and/or dealing combat damage

label: flowstone
description: Abilities that grant +N/-N and/or -N/+N

label: gives pp counters to all
description: Put +1/+1 counters on all of your creatures.

label: tome
description: Providing incremental card advantage over time (usually by tapping to draw cards, although there are variants that [tutor](tutor), [impulsive draw](impulsive-draw), etc.) has been a staple effect for noncreature artifacts since the printing of Jayemdae Tome in Alpha.

label: unnoted tracked information
description: Spells or abilities that require tracking events without explicitly noting them. See also [noted tracked information](noted-tracked-information).

label: your sacrifice matters
description: Effects that reward you for sacrificing your own permanents. Contrast [opponent sacrifice matters](opponent-sacrifice-matters).

label: counter fuel-aesthetic
description: These cards remove counters with no rules meaning as fuel.

label: forced attacker
description: Creatures that have to attack every combat if possible.

label: protects-all
description: Effects that give a form of protection to all permanents of a kind. (That may be hexproof, indestructible, protection, etc.)

label: regenerates self
description: Cards with effects that regenerate themselves.

label: restricted blocker
description: Cards that can block, but only in specific circumstances.

label: titan trigger
description: An ability that triggers on both entering the battlefield and attacking, similar to the Titan cycle from M11

label: type errata hound
description: These were all hounds, now thanks to Ruff they're all dogs, as of Core set 2021 (Or in the case of Jackal Pup, a Jackal)

label: unheroic
description: Whenever you target something that's not yours, something good happens

label: werewolf mechanic
description: Going a turn without casting spells transforms this to its back face. Casting two spells in a turn returns it to the front face. This also includes permanents that use the Daybound and Nightbound keywords to transform (see [day/night](day-night)).

label: dnd mechanic
description: Cards named after and representing DnD mechanics.

label: mm counter cost
description: Cards that put -1/-1 counters on your stuff as a cost or requirement for other effects.

label: restricted attacker
description: Cards that can only attack in specific circumstances.

label: support
description: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures.

label: swap removal
description: Sorry I messed up your stuff. Here's a thing in exchange. (See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).)

label: typal coupling
description: Cards that care about two or more different creature types.

label: abrade
description: Modal instant or sorcery spells that offer the option to either deal damage to creature(s) or remove artifact(s).

label: auto equip
description: Equipments that attach themselves to other creatures as they enter the battlefield.

label: catalog
description: Draw two cards, then discard a card.

label: changeling
description: Cards that have all creature types in all zones.

label: consult-cast
description: Consult effects that let you cast the card you find.

label: day/night
description: Effects that make use of or interact with the Day/Night mechanic introduced in Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, including but not limited to cards with the Daybound and Nightbound keywords.

label: french vanilla equipment
description: Equipment that give a creature a stat change and/or a keyword with no other effects.

label: meme
description: Cards that have become memes in Magic, or are explicitly based off of memes.

label: regrowth-artifact
description: Effects that put an artifact back in your hand from the graveyard.

label: synergy-low-power
description: Effects that care about you having creatures with power below some boundary value.

label: toughness matters
description: Other than in, you know, the usual way.

label: undergrowth
description: Cards that care about the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

label: virtual legendary
description: This card represents a one-of-a-kind creature or object (and is named accordingly), and could conceivably have been legendary. Usually cards are in this category because they were printed before legendary existed or have a mechanical need to not be legendary.

label: counterspell-creature
description: Counterspells that call out creatures specifically.

label: high mana value matters
description: Effects that care about your things with mana value above some boundary value (usually 4 or 5). See also [scales with mana value](scales-with-mana-value).

label: self-discard matters
description: Cards that reward you for tossing your own hand into the graveyard. For cards that reward you for having a small hand, see [hellbent](hellbent) and [heckbent](heckbent).

label: type errata summon creature
description: These creatures typelines at some point just read "Summon Creature", thanks to Portal!

label: cda-toughness
description: Creatures whose toughness is determined via a characteristic-defining ability.

label: charm
description: Modal spells where you pick one option out of three

label: deanimate self
description: Creatures that can stop being creatures. For noncreatures that may become creatures, see [animate self](animate-self).

label: dnd monster
description: Cards named after and representing monsters from DnD.

label: full refund
description: Cards that give you mana equal to or greater than the amount of mana spent for it, either in the form of a immediately usable mana ability, a ritual effect, or untapped lands

label: lhurgoyf
description: Cards with power and/or toughness equal to number of cards in the graveyard, or a similar variant. This term is referenced from the Mechanical Color Pie 2017 article by Mark Rosewater. See also [maro](maro) and [warlord](warlord).

label: madness
description: The specific keyword, madness (Used for applying specific subtags)

label: maro-sorcerer
description: Creatures that scale in power and toughness with the number of lands you control.

label: mass shrink
description: Shrink your opponent's whole board (or part of it).

label: modal inverse choices
description: Spells where the modal options are: X, Mirror of X

label: multiple species types
description: Creatures that have two or more types that are considered to be a species, such as "Human" or "Elf"

label: raid
description: Cards that have an upside if you attacked this turn.

label: sweeper-graveyard
description: Remove all cards from one or more graveyards

label: threaten
description: Gain control of a permanent until end of turn. For continuous theft see [theft-creature](/tags/card/theft-creature).

label: tormenting voice
description: A family of two-card rummage spells.

label: trigger from graveyard
description: Abilities that trigger from inside the graveyard.

label: vanilla aura
description: Auras that only change power and toughness.

label: copy-spell
description: Make a copy of a spell on the stack.

label: discard to exile
description: Put cards from the opponent's hand into exile, either permanently or by [banishing](banish-hand) them.

label: hate-damaged
description: Cards that do stuff to things that have already received damage.

label: manaless value
description: Cards that can provide some amount of value without untapped lands.

label: nonbasic-basic-land-type
description: Nonbasic lands that have basic land types.

label: transform-improvement
description: Cards that do the same effect but better, or the same effects but with extra when they transform.

label: untracked indefinite effect
description: Effects that last forever but aren't tracked by anything. For these purposes we're not counting ETB clones.

label: animate land
description: Cards that can turn other noncreature lands into creatures.

label: creature-ability-noncreature
description: Noncreature, non-Vehicle, non-Spacecraft permanents with abilities that become more relevant when they're animated as creatures, like combat keywords and attack triggers.

label: dnd character
description: Cards that represent Dungeons and Dragons characters: name, rules text, etc. See also the [dungeons and dragons](/tags/artwork/dungeons-and-dragons) art tag.

label: dnd item
description: Cards named after and representing DnD items.

label: eponymous
description: Non-token cards with a name matching their subtypes.

label: hate-high-mv
description: Cards that specifically hate on cards with high mana value, typically at least 3 or 4.

label: leaves trigger-self
description: Permanents with abilities that trigger when they leave the battlefield.

label: restock-to-top
description: Put cards from your graveyard on top of your library.

label: toll
description: Generate resources from your opponent's actions without them being able to pay it off.

label: tutor-to-battlefield
description: Cards that tutor something out of the library and straight onto the battlefield.

label: tutored by name
description: These cards are tutored by another specifically by their name. For the cards that tutor them, see [tutors by name](tutors-by-name).

label: type errata viashino
description: These were Viashino, now Lizards as of Modern Horizons 3.

label: vanilla equipment
description: Equipment that only changes power and toughness.

label: color break
description: Cards known to break the modern color pie, granting a color access to something it shouldn't be able to do.

label: fog-selective
description: Fog effects where the damage prevention is or has the potential to be asymmetrical in some way, usually by exempting a subset of attackers/defenders.

label: life-and-death-trigger-self
description: Permanents that have an effect that triggers when they enter the battlefield and when they die. See also [enters-and-leaves triggers](enters-and-leaves-trigger-self).

label: mathy name
description: Card names that include mathematical concepts.

label: name matters
description: Effects that care about card names: different names, same name, specific name, etc.

label: reanimate-cast
description: Cast a permanent spell from a graveyard.

label: regenerates other
description: Cards with effects that regenerate other things (and possibly including themselves.)

label: selective group hug
description: Group Hug cards that benefit only certain opponents in particular.

label: type addition from none
description: Some creatures (Commonly artifact creatures) prior to the Grand Creature Type update were printed without Creature Types.

label: burn-you
description: Sometimes your own cards hurt you the most.

label: counter preservation-self
description: When this thing leaves, put its counters on something else you control.

label: donate token
description: Effects that can create tokens under an opponents control.

label: impulse
description: Look at the top N cards and put 1+ of them into your hand. Not to be confused with Red's pseudo-card-draw effect, [impulsive draw](/tags/card/impulsive-draw).

label: rescue-land
description: Bounce a land you control back to your hand.

label: restock-to-bottom
description: Put cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.

label: revolt
description: Effects that care if a permanent (or creature, etc) you controlled left the battlefield this turn.

label: scales with multiple
description: Cards that scale as you play more copies of themselves.

label: sneak-land
description: Cards that let you put lands on the battlefield from your hand without playing them.

label: tunneling
description: Creatures with power 2 or less (sometimes 3) can't be blocked. An evasion pattern found mainly in red.

label: tutor-land-basic-forest
description: Cards that tutor basic Forest land cards.

label: tutor-land-basic-plains
description: Cards that tutor basic Plains land cards.

label: weaker in singleton formats
description: Cards that have reduced use in formats that do not allow more than one card with the same name to be used, such as in Commander or Highlander.

label: wind drake with set's mechanic
description: A 2/2 flyer for 3 with one of the set's iconic mechanics.

label: combat-neutral damage trigger
description: Creature abilities that trigger upon dealing any amount of damage, no matter if it was done in combat or not. Compare and contrast [saboteur](saboteur).

label: dnd spell
description: Cards originally from DnD sets that are named after and representing DnD spells.

label: faux targeting
description: Things that have to choose "targets", but don't actually *target*, meaning this bypasses keywords such as hexproof, protection, and shroud.

label: harmonic
description: Cards that care about artifacts and enchantments separately.

label: infusion
description: If you gained life this turn, do a thing

label: parasitic aura
description: Auras that harm the enchanted permanent's controller (usually by dealing damage or causing loss of life)

label: quote name
description: Card names that are explicitly based on an existing quote.

label: soul warden ability
description: Creatures entering the battlefield causes you to gain N life.

label: synergy-party
description: Clerics, Rogues, Warriors, and Wizards. Either cards that explicitly care for the party mechanic or couples them typally.

label: warlord
description: This creature's P/T is equal to the number of creatures you control. Named in the Color Pie 2017 article.

label: alternative crewing
description: Vehicles with crew that also have alternative ways for self-animation. For vehicles without crew see [crewless vehicle](crewless-vehicle).

label: auraify
description: Effects that turn things into auras.

label: color spent matters
description: Spells and abilities that care about the color(s) of mana spent on them.

label: flicker-slow
description: Exile a card to be brought back after a set time (usually at end of turn).

label: hate-color-choose
description: Color hate where you choose a color to hate on.

label: hellbending
description: Cards that let you go hellbent, usually by letting you empty your entire hand.

label: leaves battlefield trigger
description: Cards that trigger on something leaving the battlefield. See also [death trigger](death-trigger).

label: leaves graveyard trigger
description: Cards that have triggers whenever a card (or cards) leave your graveyard

label: mana rock
description: Noncreature artifacts that net increase your mana.

label: mixed subtypes
description: These cards have subtypes on the same type line that belong to different card types. (For example, Dryad is a creature subtype and Forest is a land subtype.)

label: tapped matters-self
description: Permanents that care about being tapped. For cards that care about other tapped permanents, see [synergy-tapped](synergy-tapped). For cards that care about the action of tapping, see [uninspired](uninspired).

label: tutor-land-basic-mountain
description: Cards that tutor basic Mountain land cards.

label: type errata naga
description: These were Naga, now Snakes as of Modern Horizons 3.

label: wish
description: Effects which allow you to bring in cards from outside the game.

label: alternate-cost-sacrifice
description: Cards that let you sacrifice permanents to play them for free/a reduced amount of mana

label: bring your own crew
description: A vehicle (or spacecraft) that comes with a built-in pilot to crew (or station) it.

label: chromatic lantern
description: Allows your lands to tap for additional colors of mana. See also [mana filter](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/mana-filter), [land conversion](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/land-conversion).

label: cost reducer
description: Cards that make other spells cost less. (Does not apply to effects that reduce a spell's own cost, like delve.)

label: daunt
description: The "can't be blocked by power 2 or less" as named by WotC. See also [gives daunt](gives-daunt).

label: fetchland
description: Lands that sacrifice to tutor for other lands

label: free discard outlet
description: Ways to discard repeatedly that require no additional cost or numerical limit.

label: group hug
description: Cards that can be used to benefit other players, including opponents, usually by giving them resources

label: mana producer
description: Nonland cards that generate mana.

label: mill-each
description: Cards that mill each player simultaneously, putting cards from top of their library to their graveyards.

label: pridemate
description: Effects that put +1/+1 counters on something when you gain life.

label: quick equip
description: Non-Equip abilities that attach equipment.

label: remove counters-other
description: Remove counters from your opponents or their stuff.

label: surge
description: Get a benefit if you've cast another spell this turn.

label: synergy-solo-attack
description: Cards that care about attacking with only one creature

label: trumpet blast
description: Instants that give +N/+0 to all your (attacking) creatures until end of turn.

label: tutor-land-basic-swamp
description: Cards that tutor basic Swamp land cards.

label: twiddle
description: Tap or untap something.

label: unique counter
description: These cards use a type of counter no other card does.

label: wheel-one-sided
description: Wheel effects that affect one player (usually you).

label: aikido
description: Effects that turn your opponent's strength against them.

label: ditch hand
description: Cards that let you get rid of your current hand in some way or other.

label: enrage
description: An effect that triggers when the creature (or attached/enchanted creature) takes damage.

label: has identical token
description: A token exists that's identical to these cards. See more: [token versions of cards](token-versions-of-cards).

label: hate-planeswalker
description: Effects that specifically answer or are better against planeswalkers. This does not include effects that happen to trigger whether it's a player or planeswalker and don't help remove the planeswalker.

label: homeward effect
description: Regain control of stuff you own.

label: lure-limited
description: This creature must be blocked, but not necessarily by all creatures like a true lure.

label: metalcraft
description: Effects when the player controls three or more artifacts.

label: ninjutsu
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Ninjutsu. Should be 1-1 with kw:ninjutsu.

label: powerstone mana
description: Mana that can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells.

label: references keyword
description: Cards that call back to a keyword or mechanic from an older set. It's like the "References/Referenced By" relationship, but for a mechanic instead of an individual card.

label: restock-any
description: Return any cards to your library from the graveyard, not caring about their types.

label: splits on death
description: Cards with abilities that create multiple creature tokens when a creature dies.

label: synergy-graveyard-cast
description: Cards that care about casting spells from graveyards.

label: synergy-multicolor
description: Cards that care about you using multicolored cards.

label: tapper-permanent
description: Tap target permanent.

label: tutor-card
description: Cards that tutor any cards.

label: tutor-land-basic-island
description: Cards that tutor basic Island land cards.

label: upkeep cost
description: Cards that ask you to pay some kind of cost on your upkeep step.

label: vivid
description: Cards that care about the number of colors among permanents you control.

label: animate artifact
description: Cards that can turn other noncreature artifacts into creatures. See also [animate vehicle](/tags/card/animate-vehicle).

label: armoring
description: A toughness-pumping ability. See also [firebreathing] in red and [shade pump] in black.

label: blood artist ability
description: Cards that have abilities along the lines of: "Whenever creature dies target/each opponent loses X life and you gain X life."

label: burn bright with set mechanic
description: Cards like [Burn Bright](https://scryfall.com/card/rna/93/burn-bright) or [Trumpet Blast](https://scryfall.com/card/m10/160/trumpet-blast), but with the set's mechanic.

label: drain strength
description: One thing gets bigger, another gets smaller. See also [persecution effect](persecution-effect).

label: exalted
description: Creatures attacking alone get +N/+N

label: fling
description: Sacrifice a creature to deal its power in damage to something. See also [bombard](/tags/card/bombard), [one-sided fight](/tags/card/one-sided-fight), [fling-self](fling-self).

label: high flying
description: Flying creatures that can only block other flying creatures. See also [gives high flying](gives-high-flying).

label: inscryption achievement
description: Cards that share a name with achievements in the PC game Inscryption

label: keyword errata flash
description: Cards featuring Flash, before it was keyworded in Time Spiral

label: lightning bolt redux
description: These cards deal 3 damage for {R} under the right circumstances, like Lightning Bolt.

label: misnomer
description: Cards with names that imply something that card isn't, such as a mechanic or a color.

label: outnumber
description: Deal damage to a creature based on your creature count.

label: paradox
description: Cards that care about casting spells from anywhere other than your hand.

label: peek-hand
description: Take a quick look at a players hand

label: rainbow land
description: A land that can net one or more mana of any color.

label: recycle
description: Sacrifice a thing to get another thing back from the graveyard.

label: ritual
description: Spells that add mana.

label: tutor-land-forest
description: Cards that tutor Forest cards.

label: wingman
description: Creatures with flying that give other creatures flying until end of turn when they attack.

label: alternate-equip-cost
description: Equipment with non-standard equip costs (e.g. equip restriction, sacrifice stuff, etc.)

label: buttstrike
description: Creatures assign damage equal to their toughness.

label: color-choose-land
description: Lands that produce a mana of the color you specified when entering

label: counterspell-exile
description: For counterspelling that exiles the spell.

label: extra untap
description: Cards that give you a way to untap things en masse, either with a new untap step or by an ability that untaps multiple things

label: french vanilla walker
description: French vanilla creatures with only a landwalk ability.

label: mana increaser
description: Cards that increase the mana produced by mana producers, usually lands.

label: mutual sacrifice
description: Everyone sacrifices something.

label: non-mana ward
description: Ward abilities with non-mana payments.

label: noncreature french vanilla
description: These noncreature, nonvehicle, nonspacecraft cards have only keyword abilities. (For vehicles and spacecraft, see [french vanilla](french-vanilla).)

label: overrun
description: Effects that grant trample and +P/+T

label: prevent mass blockers
description: Cards that sweepingly prevent blocks from happening.

label: pseudo-proliferate
description: Effects that sorta-proliferate some counters.

label: real life animal name
description: Card names that match real world english animal names. "Manta ray" is accepted, while "Hurr jackal" is not. Adjectives can disqualify a card unless it is a part of their name. "Giant ladybug" is a species name and therefore accepted, while "Venomous dragonfly" is not.

label: remove counters-you
description: Remove counters from your permanents or yourself.

label: restock-all
description: Cards that put your entire graveyard into your library

label: school name
description: Card names that include things you might find/do in schools.

label: sift
description: Draw three cards, then discard a card. Not to be confused with [compulsive research](compulsive-research) or [probe](probe).

label: stalking
description: The "can't be blocked by more than one creature" ability, [as named by the designers](http://markrosewater.tumblr.com/post/178266363158). See also [gives stalking](gives-stalking).

label: tutor-artifact
description: Cards that tutor artifact cards.

label: tutor-land-plains
description: Cards that tutor Plains cards.

label: tutor-to-top
description: Cards that tutor something and put it on the top of the library.

label: typal-neo-solo-attack
description: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty coupled Samurai and Warriors as card types that care about attacking alone.

label: afflict
description: An ability that makes defending players lose life for blocking. It exists primarily as a keyword although variants that mimic the mechanic exists.

label: animate vehicle
description: Cards that can turn other vehicles into creatures (other than by crewing them), permanently or temporarily. See also [animate artifact](/tags/card/animate-artifact).

label: artifactify
description: Effects that turn things into artifacts.

label: catch up
description: Players who have less get more.

label: cheat death-self
description: Cards that return themselves to the battlefield or to your hand at the moment they die.

label: clash-like
description: Cards that compare the mana values of multiple players' revealed cards

label: compulsive research
description: Cards with a function of "draw N cards, then discard 2 unless you discard [type]"

label: converge
description: Spells that do something equal to the number of colors spent to cast them.

label: copy-token
description: Effects that copy specifically tokens, like populate.

label: counterspell-noncreature
description: Counterspells that call out noncreatures specifically.

label: cranial plating
description: Buffs based on the number of artifacts or Equipment you control/in play. See also [armament ability](armament-ability). For the enchantment version, see [ethereal armor](ethereal-armor).

label: creature type name
description: Cards with names comprised of creature types.

label: death trigger opponent
description: Cards that trigger when an opponent's permanent is sent to a graveyard.

label: delve
description: Exile cards from your graveyard to reduce the cost

label: earthquake
description: Spells that deal damage to creatures without flying.

label: exile on resolution
description: Cards that exile themselves once they've finished all their effects. Commonly seen on extra turn cards.

label: exponential
description: Effects that involve some amount of exponential growth. This can be an exponential value, or a token creation effect that would be exponential if allowed to progress unhindered. See [quadratic](quadratic) for a different, but similar kind of effect.

label: filterland
description: Lands that take one mana and give you back another colour of mana, sometimes in greater quantities.

label: impact effect
description: Effects that have your creatures do ETB damage or life loss.

label: life-total-matters-self
description: Cards that care about your life total being above or below a certain amount. This doesn’t include cards like Phyrexian Arena that simply want you to be alive.

label: neo-regenerate
description: An activated ability that says "this gains indestructible; tap it" is the new Regenerate.

label: passive ability
description: Planeswalkers with non-loyalty abilities.

label: power matters-individual
description: Effects which care about the power of one creature (or multiple creatures individually, as opposed to as a total).

label: power matters-total
description: Effects which care about the total power of some set of creatures.

label: punisher
description: Effects that give you a choice of two damnations.

label: repeated keyword
description: Repetition or stacking of a keyword.

label: restock-instant
description: Effects that put an instant back in your library from the graveyard.

label: restock-sorcery
description: Effects that put a sorcery back in your library from the graveyard.

label: sacrifice outlet-universal
description: Allows you to sacrifice any permanent, regardless of its card type.

label: strive
description: Cards that require paying an additional cost per additional target.

label: synergy-tapped
description: Effects that care about your tapped permanents. For cards that care about something *becoming* tapped, see [uninspired](uninspired). For cards that care about being tapped themselves, see [tapped matters-self](tapped-matters-self).

label: tapland
description: Non-basic lands which come into play tapped

label: token errata
description: These cards used to make a different type of token, which has since been updated. For type lines, see [Type Errata](type-errata)

label: trigger from exile
description: Abilities that trigger from inside exile.

label: tutor-land-mountain
description: Cards that tutor Mountain cards.

label: tutors by name
description: These cards tutor other cards by their name. For their tutor targets, see [tutored by name](tutored-by-name).

label: typal-goblin-orc
description: Green, mean, and ready to hit you in the spleen. In Lord of the Rings, often seen alongside Army.

label: typal-share
description: Tribal effects that care about shared creature types.

label: type addition book
description: The release of Secrets of Strixhaven introduced the Book subtype, with errata to previous artifacts.

label: addendum
description: Instant-speed cards that do something extra if you played them during your main phase.

label: block additional
description: Block additional creatures beyond just the one.

label: class type only
description: These creatures have only a class type, and no type correlating to whatever fantasy race they might belong to.

label: combat ping
description: Cards that deal a small amount of damage during the combat step.

label: doesn't untap
description: Cards that prevent their own untapping in some way.

label: earthbend
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Earthbend. Should be 1:1 with kw:earthbend.

label: enters-and-leaves-trigger-self
description: Permanents that have an effect that triggers when the permanent enters the battlefield or leaves the battlefield to any zone. Compare [life-and-death trigger](life-and-death-trigger-self).

label: firebend-like
description: When a creature attacks, get mana of some kind

label: hate-wide
description: The more creatures your opponent controls, the more these cards scale up to punish them for it.

label: hungry demon
description: Cards that make you sacrifice a creature, either automatically or with a downside if you can't or won't.

label: imprint
description: Cards that exile other cards (or themselves) to use as reference marker for another effect.

label: interrupt
description: This spell was an interrupt before Sixth Edition Rules introduced the stack.

label: keyword errata surveil
description: Cards that Surveil but were either printed before the keyword was made, or before it was made deciduous in The Brothers' War

label: mana egg
description: Mana rocks that have to be sacrificed to add mana. They may ramp or merely filter your mana.

label: mana storage
description: Cards that can be used to store mana for later phases and/or turns. The storing methods are varied—many use counters to count stored mana, while others create tokens.

label: naya ferocious
description: Cards that care about you controlling creatures with power 5 or greater.

label: peek-library
description: Look at some number of cards from the top of libraries

label: provoke lite
description: "That creature must block this one this combat if able." It's like Provoke, but without the untapping. Also similar to [lure](lure) and [lure-limited](lure-limited).

label: repeatable noncreature tokens
description: Repeatable ways to create noncreature tokens

label: shares name with a mechanic
description: Regardless of whether it relates to that mechanic.

label: single-minded color hate
description: Cards that hate on a specific color (or colors), and do nothing else if that color isn't present.

label: synergy-face-down
description: Cards that have synergy with the various face down mechanics in the game, such as manifest, morph, cloak, etc.

label: tutor-instant
description: Cards that tutor instant cards.

label: tutor-land-swamp
description: Cards that tutor Swamp cards.

label: tutor-mv
description: Cards that tutor cards with a certain mana value.

label: typal-choose
description: Choose a creature type with which to synergize.

label: typal-non-human
description: Cards that care about every creature that does not have the Human creature type. See also the Mutate keyword.

label: unique-type-exclusion
description: Cards that say "non-type" where no other card does that for that type.

label: arc lightning
description: Deals X damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.

label: awaken
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Awaken. Should be 1-1 with kw:awaken.

label: ball lightning
description: A high-damage one-turn creature.

label: battalion
description: Attacking with at least two other creatures matters.

label: bounceable aura
description: Auras you can bounce back to your hand.

label: clone
description: Cards that enter as copies of other things

label: conditional aura
description: Auras that have a different effect depending on what is being enchanted.

label: consult-onto-battlefield
description: Consult effects that put the card you find onto the battlefield.

label: cost ignorer
description: Cards that allow you to bypass mana costs. This could be by making the spell free or by setting a static cost that's independent of the original.

label: counter fuel-any
description: Use any type of counter as fuel.

label: counter increaser
description: Cards that increase the amount of counters that would be given to something.

label: counterspell-ability
description: Cards that counter activated/triggered abilities. NOT for abilities that counter things.

label: counterspell-artifact
description: Counterspells that call out artifacts specifically.

label: counterspell-instant
description: Counterspells that call out instants specifically.

label: curiosity-like
description: Cards that can give you some form of card advantage upon dealing damage, usually combat damage, to a player.

label: cycle-dft-team-captain
description: A cycle of legendary creatures featuring the team captains of each team participating in the second edition of the [Ghirapur Grand Prix](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/artwork/ghirapur-grand-prix).

label: discard-symmetrical
description: Force each player to discard cards without drawing back up. See also [wheel-symmetrical](wheel-symmetrical).

label: division
description:
Cards that ask for a divided value.
For cards that include a fractional value or a number that is not a whole number, see [non-integer](non-integer).

label: ethereal armor
description: Buffs based on the number of enchantments or Auras you control/in play. See also [Uril ability](uril-ability). For the artifact version, see [cranial plating](cranial-plating).

label: formidable
description: Effects that care if you control creatures with a total power 8 or greater.

label: hand size increase
description: Cards that increase the maximum amount of cards you can hold.

label: hate-removal-sacrifice
description: Punish your opponent for trying to make you sacrifice your creatures. As a rule of thumb, to count, it should still work even if they make you sac your whole battlefield. See also [prevent sacrifice](prevent-sacrifice).

label: hellbent
description: Effects that care about having no cards in hand.

label: impulsive draw
description: Cards which let you cast a card for a limited time off the top of a library (via exile). Use it or lose it. Typically a red card advantage mechanic. See also [impulsive mill](impulsive-mill). For the effect seen on the [card Impulse](/card/vis/34), see the [tag impulse](impulse).

label: ingest
description: Permanents that exile one or more cards from the top of an opponent's library upon dealing combat damage.

label: land conversion
description: Effects that change or add land types and affect how lands produce mana.

label: lure
description: All creatures able to block this creature must do so. See also [lure-limited](lure-limited) and [provoke lite](provoke-lite).

label: mana dork egg
description: Creatures that can be sacrificed to add mana.

label: mana spent matters
description: Effects that care about the amount, type, and/or qualities of mana spent to do a thing.

label: opaline effect
description: Whenever your stuff becomes the target of a spell and/or ability, you draw a card.

label: opponent lifegain
description: Cards that make your opponents gain life.

label: potentially free
description: Cards that can be played without spending any resources (Mana, life, tapping creatures, etc). Cards must be able to be not free, to be potentially free.

label: regrowth
description: Effects that return other cards from your graveyard to your hand.

label: renown
description: Collection tag used to apply the various tags that comprise the keyword Renown. Should be 1:1 with kw:renown.

label: slith ability
description: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to a player, it gets a +1/+1 counter.

label: times resolved matters
description: Effects that check how many times they've resolved and do something different based on the result.

label: tutor-creature
description: Cards that tutor creature cards.

label: young pyromancer ability
description: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a creature token.

label: affinity undergrowth
description: Affinity which cares about how many creatures are in your graveyard.

label: armament ability
description: An ability in which the P/T of one or more creatures can increase based on the number of equipment attached to one creature outside of the equipment's effects of being attached. See also [cranial plating](cranial-plating).

label: bushido
description: Whenever X blocks or becomes blocked, it's power and toughness is modified until end of turn.

label: catch-22
description: At the end of turn, if a condition isn't met, a consequence is given.

label: consult
description: Dig through your library until you find a card meeting some criteria.

label: counterspell-sacrifice
description: Counterspell abilities that require sacrifice as a cost.

label: creatureland
description: Lands that can animate themselves.

label: cycle-blb-hybrid
description: A cycle of 2 colour hybrid creatures from Bloomburrow.

label: cycle-ecl-u-behold
description: A cycle of creatures that ask you to behold a creature type or pay {2} as an additional cost.

label: day zero errata
description: These cards received errata before or immediately after their initial release.

label: detain
description: Prevent a creature from attacking, blocking, or using it's activated abilities until one's next turn.

label: differently named lands matter
description: These cards want you to have multiple lands with different names.

label: donate rampant growth
description: Cards that allow you to ramp another player's mana by putting a land from their (or your) deck onto the battlefield. Compare [donate mana](donate-mana), which lets you add mana directly to their mana pool.

label: exchange control
description: Here's my stuff, give me yours.

label: extra land
description: Effects that allow you to put additional lands from your hand, top of the library, or graveyard onto the battlefield outside of your normal once-per-turn land play. For effects that let you search your library for cards, refer to [tutor land](/tags/card/tutor-land).

label: flicker-permanent
description: Flicker effects that work on all permanent types: artifact, creature, enchantment, land, planeswalker, and battle.

label: fog
description: Effects that can prevent all or most of the damage from an entire combat, similar to the card Fog. See also [pseudo-fog](https://tagger.scryfall.com/tags/card/pseudo-fog).

label: frost armor
description: Spells cost additional mana to target stuff you control.

label: gives changeling
description: Granting the changeling ability doesn't actually do anything in the layer system, so these cards grant all creature types.

label: hate-low-toughness
description: Cards that punish low toughness in ways beyond just the usual [damaging](burn-creature) or [shrinking](removal-toughness) the creature.

label: mana ability with extra effect
description: Mana abilities that have some extra effect upon activating them, meaning that they can do actions in strange cases such as during the casting of a split second card and usually can't be prevented in any way.

label: no-creature-type
description: Creatures without any creature types

label: peek-face-down
description: Cards that allow you to look at face-down creatures you don't control.

label: poison opponents
description: Gives poison counters directly to opponents, preferebly to all at once, without damage.

label: processing
description: Removes a card of your opponent's from the exile zone for value or to deny them resources.

label: pseudo-cycling
description: Cards that discard themselves to achieve a similar function to cycling, but aren't cycling.

label: ransom
description: Cards that remove permanents unless a cost is paid.

label: reanimate-from-any
description: Reanimate from any graveyard.

label: removes-mm-counters-self
description: Removes -1/-1 counters, but only from itself, not from other creatures.

label: shapesharing
description: Something on the battlefield becomes a copy of something else.

label: sleeping enchantment
description: Enchantments that permanently "wake up" and become creatures.

label: sneaky-self-trigger
description: Cards that are worded in a way that makes it easy to miss that they trigger one of their own abilities.

label: soothsaying
description: Look at the top N cards of a library and rearrange them.

label: specter ability
description: Damaging the opponent strips cards out of their hand.

label: sunder
description: Remove everything attached to a permanent while possibly leaving the permanent behind. (Some of these taggings consider the permanent might be indestructible.)

label: synergy-color-each
description: Cards that have a scaling effect for each color on permanents or cards. See [synergy-color-every](synergy-color-every) for cards that care specifically about five-colored cards.

label: tax attack
description: Cards that prevent players from attacking unless they pay a cost, usually mana

label: tutor-sorcery
description: Cards that tutor sorcery cards.

label: tutor-to-graveyard
description: Tutor cards into your graveyard.

label: type errata dinosaur
description: These creatures that were obviously dinosaurs the whole time, gained or changed to a Dinosaur typeline with the release of Ixalan.

label: unique creature type
description: Creatures with one or more single creature types that are unique to them, not counting creature types on tokens.

label: unpreventable-damage
description: Damage can't be prevented, whether universally or for specific sources.

label: unprinted token
description: Cards whose tokens haven't yet been printed in paper.

label: battle cry
description: Whenever this attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

label: behold
description: Cards that have an effect if you control something or reveal from your hand a card with a specific attribute.

label: berserk
description: A creature gets a power boost, but will die this turn.

label: buff mana
description: Mana that comes with additional benefits when spent.

label: cards in exile matter
description: Mechanics that care about the cards in Exile.

label: commander identity matters
description: Cards that care about your commander's color identity.

label: cone spell
description: Based on Cone of Flame, these are cards with a theme of doing something three times with the values 1, 2, and 3.

label: counterspell-enchantment
description: Counterspells that call out enchantments specifically.

label: counterspell-sorcery
description: Counterspells that call out sorceries specifically.

label: creates token of a card
description: These cards create a token with characteristics seen on a printed card. There may not be an associated physical token. See the parent tag above for more information.

label: cycle-m11-c-pw-signature
description: See also [cycle-m11-u-pw-signature](/tags/card/cycle-m11-u-pw-signature)

label: deanimate
description: Uncreaturize a creature. For creatures that deanimate themselves, see [deanimate self](deanimate-self).

label: delayed cantrip
description: Draw a card next turn.

label: explore-like
description: Look at the top card, then you may draw it. If you don't, you may put it away.

label: gainland
description: Lands that have you gain life when they enter the battlefield.

label: gives castable from graveyard
description: Allows you to play other cards from the graveyard.

label: gives stalking
description: Cards that make creatures only be blockable by no more than one creature, also known as "[stalking](stalking)".

label: graveyard seal
description: Prevent interaction with the graveyard or reanimation, or make it more difficult.

label: hate empty hand
description: Cards that punish opponents for having few or no cards in hand. For cards that care about their controller's hand being empty, see [hellbent](hellbent) and [heckbent](heckbent).

label: haven
description: Exile your permanents to return them at much later point, essentially storing them somewhere safe. Not to be confused with [flicker](/tags/card/flicker) or [banish](banish).

label: mm counters matter
description: Cards that care about -1/-1 counters in some way.

label: multiplayer
description: Cards that interact with all of the players in the game. They might scale with the number of players or affect the turn order for example.

label: nightveil theft
description: Cards that effectively "draw" from your opponent's library by exiling their cards and letting you play them.

label: old banish templating
description: Banish effects in which the "exile" and "return" effects are separate linked abilities.

label: old blocking deathtouch
description: Before the keyword was made evergreen in Magic 2010, deathtouch was sometimes a triggered ability based on blocking. See also [old damage deathtouch](old-damage-deathtouch).

label: onomatopoeia
description: Boom! Crash! Kapow!

label: outlast mentor
description: Creatures with Outlast that boost your creatures that have counters on them.

label: pierce
description: Cards whose excess damage is dealt to their target's controller instead.

label: pseudo-fog
description: Effects that can protect you from an entire combat phase, similar to the card Fog, but using less conventional means than damage prevention.

label: rack effect
description: Players get burned or lose life for having a small hand.

label: regrowth-any
description: Bring back a card of any card type from your graveyard to your hand.

label: remove-from-stack
description: Cards that remove spells from the stack without countering them.

label: speed matters
description: Effects that care about speed directly, other than max speed.

label: synergy-dice
description: Various effects that either make dice rolling better, or love when you [roll dice](dice-roll).

label: synergy-sacrifice-self
description: When *I* am sacrificed...

label: synergy-surveil
description: Beneficial effects for the Surveil keyword.

label: top matters
description: The top card of your library matters for purposes other than playing it or drawing it.

label: torment
description: A stock punisher effect where you force an opponent to choose between discarding, sacrificing, or losing life.

label: tutor-artifact-equipment
description: Cards that tutor Equipment cards.

label: tutor-enchantment-aura
description: Cards that tutor Aura cards.

label: tutor-land-any
description: Tutors with restricted effects that are able to search for any land.

label: tutor-land-island
description: Cards that tutor Island cards.

label: unique cr reference
description: There is an entire rule in the CR just to cover this card and no other card.

label: unique p/t
description: Cards with a power/toughness not seen on any other card.

label: zoo
description: Cards that create multiple tokens of different types.

label: absorb
description: A static ability preventing a fixed number of damage to permanents or players.

label: affinity for land type
description: Affinity abilities that care about land types.

label: alternate loss condition
description: New ways for you to lose the game

label: attacking matters-any
description: Cards that care about anyone attacking.

label: brainstorm
description: Draw a number of cards, then put cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

label: burn-self
description: Creatures deal damage to themselves.

label: copy from graveyard
description: "Brings back" a copy of a permanent card in a graveyard instead of the original. Could be a token copy, could be turning another card into a copy of it.

label: counterspell-bounce
description: Counterspells that instead "counter" by bouncing the spell.

label: cycle-m11-u-pw-signature
description: See also [cycle-m11-c-pw-signature](/tags/card/cycle-m11-c-pw-signature)

label: damage increaser
description: Things deal +N damage. See also [damage multiplier](/tags/card/damage-multiplier).

label: damage multiplier
description: Things deal double or triple damage. See also [damage increaser](/tags/card/damage-increaser).

label: defector
description: Permanents that move around the board on their own

label: deprecated legend type
description: These cards were originally printed with the Legend creature type. Their type line read “Summon Legend” or “Creature — Legend”.

label: devour
description: Before a creature enters the battlefield, the player may sacrifice a number of permanents and the creature will enter with +1/+1 counters on it in relation to the number of permanents sacrificed.

label: emerge-from-creature
description: Cards where you can sacrifice a creature and subtract its cost from the mana you pay

label: fake flying
description: Creatures without flying that can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach. See also [gives fake flying](gives-fake-flying).

label: fulfilled futureshift
description: This card was initially futureshifted, and has now received its proper print in its future expansion.

label: game name
description: Cards that are named after game terms.

label: gives evasion
description: Cards that make a creature harder or impossible to block.

label: hate-colorless
description: Hate on colorless cards. See also [hate-color](/tags/card/hate-color) for color hate.

label: hate full hand
description: Cards that punish an opponent for having lots of cards in hand.

label: hate-target
description: Cards that make it harder for your opponents to target your stuff or punish them for doing so.

label: high x matters
description: Cards with X values that do something extra beyond the X effect, as long as X surpasses a specific threshold.

label: hurricane
description: Spells that deal damage to creatures with flying. See [earthquake](earthquake) for the inverse effect.

label: illusion ability
description: Permanents that sacrifice themselves if they get targeted by anything

label: inspired
description: Cards that care about the action of untapping a permanent. For cards that care about untapped permanents, see [synergy-untapped](synergy-untapped) and [untapped matters-self](untapped-matters-self).

label: instant speed discard
description: Discard effects that can deny the opponent the card they draw each turn

label: landhome
description: An old two-part mechanic: you had to control a land of a certain type to keep this creature on the battlefield, and the opponent needed to control a land of the same type to be attacked by it. It often got used in just one of the halves, so we tag either half.

label: leveler
description: Cards that level up. No relation to the card Leveler.

label: lich effect
description: Effects which turn damage into the loss of cards or permanents. See also [Deal with the devil](/tags/card/deal-with-the-devil)

label: lifegain to damage
description: Transforms player lifegain into player damage.

label: lobotomy
description: Exile all cards of a particular name from a player's hand, library, and/or graveyard. See also [nevermore](/tags/card/nevermore), which forbids certain cards from being cast.

label: mana gorger
description: Cards that grow bigger when players cast spells.

label: mana leak series
description: Soft counterspells with mana value N that cost more than N to pay off

label: marauder
description: Enters and causes all players to sacrifice a creature.

label: mass regrowth
description:
Return everything (or every 
thing of a kind) from your graveyard to your hand (or potentially do this).

label: mill-exile
description: Exile cards from the top of a library.

label: miniwheel
description: Discard your hand, and draw less than seven cards. See also [wheel](/tags/card/wheel) for drawing (potentially) seven or more cards.

label: multi-copy
description: Copy effects that grant you multiple copies of a permanent at a time.

label: nonstandard-bestow
description: Bestow creatures that, when attached to a creature, do something other than exactly providing a P/T boost equal to their P/T and their other abilities.

label: old lifelink
description: Before lifelink was keyworded in Magic 2010, it was a triggered ability.

label: painland
description: Lands that deal damage to the user upon tapping them for mana. For the original cycle of painlands, see [cycle-painland](cycle-painland) or [is:painland](https://scryfall.com/search?q=is%3Apainland).

label: pillage effect
description: Cards that loot/rummage and create Treasure(s).

label: quadratic
description: Cards with some kind of effect increases to the second power. This could mean something like a power increase, token creation, or otherwise. See [exponential](exponential) for a different, but similar kind of effect.

label: radiate
description: Effects that copy spells and abilities targeting a single creature.

label: reanimate
description: Return permanent cards from the graveyard to the battlefield.

label: relentless
description: Cards you can have more than the usual number of in your deck.

label: restock-self
description: Cards that restock themselves.

label: ritual-untap
description: Single use effects that untap mana-producing permanents greater than or equal to their cost

label: rummage to library
description: Rummage with the discarded cards tucked in your library.

label: rupture spire
description: Not only does this land enter tapped, it also requires you to tap another land when you play it.

label: scales with damage dealt
description: Effects that scale with how much damage a creature deals.

label: skulk
description: Creatures with power greater than X's power can't block it.

label: sneak
description: Put a permanent from your hand onto the battlefield. (With or without a requirement to sacrifice it later.) Not related to the Sneak keyword first seen in TMT.

label: sol land
description: Lands that mimic the mana ability of Sol Ring: add two colorless mana.

label: state trigger
